JobState.description: How a single submitted run is progressing.

oneOf.description: The job has been accepted and is executing (seeding, the harness session, validation). This covers the whole up-to-an-hour run.
The run finished and produced a [`RunRecord`]. The record's own `status.state` distinguishes a completed run from one the run lifecycle classified as failed/unevaluable.
The run could not be driven to a record at all (the definition would not resolve, the container would not start, the harness was unavailable, the runtime cap fired). `detail` carries the reason.

description: A point-in-time view of a job, returned by the status endpoint.

detail.description: A human-readable failure reason, present when `state` is `failed`.

id.description: The job id (`POST /runs` returns this; the other endpoints key on it).

record.description: The produced run record, present once `state` is `succeeded`.

state.description: Where the job is in its lifecycle.

title: JobStatus
